newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dong Yang in 1-for-4 rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Dong Yang in 1-for-4 rights offer.

text.p: South Korea's Dong Yang Gang Chul Co Ltd said on Tuesday it plans to make a 1-for-4 rights issue in December to raise funds investment in facilities and to improve its financial structure.
Dong Yang will issue 353,808 new common shares, 20 percent of which will be offered to employees. The rest will be allocated to its shareholders as of November 4.
Subscription is set for November 27 and 28, with payment due by December 12.
The rights issue will be made at a 30 percent discount to a base issue price to be announced at a later date.
With the rights issue offer, the company's paid-in capital will rise to 7.67 billion won from 5.9 billion.
Dong Yang shares closed at 24,600 won on Tuesday, up 400.
